checkpoint: pointer-following frozen pane, release settling, compact header and gitignore review
source_digest_scope: Sorted names + NUL + bytes + NUL: src, benches, examples, tests, assets, tools excluding pycache; Cargo/build/toolchain/format/lint/Make/launcher/gitignore. Portable Cargo.lock bytes.

environment.build: release, thin LTO, one codegen unit
environment.cargo_sources: 41 temporary upstream source substitutions; unchanged 266-package version/dependency graph; portable registry lock restored afterward
environment.renderer: Ratatui TestBackend; separate actual SGR/CSI optimized PTY smoke
environment.control: Three fresh processes per size; shared host, concurrent preview/PTY qualification, scheduling and caches uncontrolled

workloads.capture: 40 actual MouseDown + interactive-frame captures, bounded to 20000 cells
workloads.held: 200 actual drag + interactive frames; exact grab-offset position checked
workloads.settling: 400 injected-time tick + interactive frames across 40 release transitions; immediate durable order and complete finish checked

correctness: Each motion cycle independently checks original and intermediate pane orders, exact pointer offset, readable bytes and final settling completion. Fixtures/events/syntax warmup are outside timers; capture timers include actual snapshot allocation/cell clones.
limitations: No before/after speedup claim: snapshot/settling workloads are new and the header now has one more reading row.
Frame samples measure CPU/wall work for composition, not the 16 ms pacing interval or physical terminal input/paint.
Settling uses controlled Instants without sleeps; real event-loop cadence is separately exercised through the PTY.
Whole-process peak RSS/wall include setup. RSS is not an allocation count.
Physical Alacritty and clean-registry/advisory qualification remain unavailable.
Oversized captures fall back to target highlighting; dimension-changing drops use real reflow without frozen-cell stretching.
